title: EMS Energy Meter Communication Configuration
description: Modbus connection and device configuration for the energy meter. Supports both Modbus RTU (RS485) and Modbus TCP. Measures AC power import/export, voltage, current, and energy totals.

_schema_version.description: Schema version for migration detection. Must match the schema expected version.

connection.description: Modbus transport layer configuration. Protocol selects RTU (RS485 serial) or TCP (Ethernet).

protocol.description: Modbus transport protocol. 'rtu' uses RS485 serial, 'tcp' uses Ethernet.

slave_id.description: Modbus slave/unit ID of the energy meter device.

device.description: Serial device path for Modbus RTU. Example: /dev/ttyUSB2 or /dev/ttyS3.

baud_rate.description: Serial baud rate for Modbus RTU. Must match meter hardware configuration. Default: 9600.

parity.description: Serial parity for Modbus RTU. N=None, E=Even, O=Odd. Default: N.

stopbits.description: Number of serial stop bits for Modbus RTU. Default: 1.

host.description: IP address or hostname of the energy meter for Modbus TCP.

port.description: TCP port number for Modbus TCP. Standard Modbus TCP port is 502.

device.description: Meter device parameters. Defines the meter model for correct register mapping and CT ratio for current scaling.

model.description: Energy meter model identifier. Selects the correct register map and scaling factors for the specific meter hardware.

ct_ratio.description: Current transformer ratio used with the meter. Example: 200 means 200:1 CT (200A primary to 1A secondary). Used to scale current readings to actual amperes.

timing.description: Modbus polling interval and timeout configuration for meter communication.

poll_interval_ms.description: How often to poll meter registers for power and energy readings. 1Hz (1000ms) is typical for energy accounting.

timeout_ms.description: Modbus request timeout. If no response within this window, the request is retried or a fault is raised.
